what: QED on-chain vault journey through the backend API
howToReproduce: node scripts/vault-journey.ts <report.json>, with the engine, API and vault service running

steps.name: the vault service answers through QED's API
steps.expected: available, and nobody's or yours
steps.observed: available true; held by nobody; Local Anvil chain 31337 · valueless test tokens · development keys

steps.name: wiring the contracts: two owner transactions under one approval
steps.expected: executed
steps.observed: done: executed

steps.name: signing a mandate
steps.expected: executed; an active mandate of 25 a payment, 60 a day, 200 in all
steps.observed: done: executed; version 1, 25 / 60 / 200, status active

steps.name: the approval that signed it is on the mandate
steps.expected: the mandate carries this approval's id
steps.observed: mandate approval apr_1m7w7acneepfk4; used apr_1m7w7acneepfk4

steps.name: a payment to the one approved outside payee
steps.expected: executed; 3 tUSD leaves the treasury
steps.observed: done: executed; treasury 100 to 97

steps.name: a payment to a name that is not in the owner's book
steps.expected: refused before any terms exist
steps.observed: 422 unknown_payee

steps.name: a payment promised for a later day, and money the owner sets aside for a creditor
steps.expected: both executed; two open promises of 2 and 4 tUSD; 6 tUSD no longer free; nothing has left
steps.observed: done: executed; done: executed; open #1 2 by agent, #2 4 by owner; set aside 6; balance 97

steps.name: what a payment may be, read without preparing anything
steps.expected: 5 of the co-signer's 10 tUSD left; 5 is the most payable; one unit more is refused; reading uses none of the service's budget
steps.observed: left 5 of 10, used 5; most payable 5; 5.000001 allowed false, failing earned-autonomy; budget 5,5,0 then 5,5,0

steps.name: paying a promise before it is due
steps.expected: refused; nothing sent
steps.observed: done: refused

steps.name: the owner's own money out and back in; more than is free is refused
steps.expected: 5 tUSD out, 5 back, and the oversized withdrawal sends nothing
steps.observed: withdraw done: executed (97 to 92); deposit done: executed (97); oversized done: refused

steps.name: naming a smaller venue set and then the full one again
steps.expected: three named; an attack cannot start meanwhile; five named again
steps.observed: done: executed, named 0,1,2; attack proposal 409 venue_set_changed; done: executed, 5 named

steps.name: the vault service keeps its own budget
steps.expected: a count of what was used in the rolling hour, per class
steps.observed: proposals 10/240; operations 11/240; economies 0/4

steps.name: a limit check and a quote read without signing anything
steps.expected: allowed; expected output and the provable bound
steps.observed: allowed true; expected 9.107516 tEUR, bound 9.107519, 0.329 ppm apart; source QEDExecution.quoteBound and pool reserves on the local Anvil chain

steps.name: a conversion inside the limits
steps.expected: executed in eight steps; the reserve gains what the receipt says
steps.observed: done: executed; 8 steps (interpret, mandate, owner, cosigner, plan, submit, receipt, reconcile); reserve +9.107516 tEUR; last trade 9.107516

steps.name: sending the same approved conversion again
steps.expected: the same job, and no second conversion
steps.observed: 200; duplicate true; job the same; reserve still +9.107516

steps.name: a conversion above the mandate's limit for one payment
steps.expected: refused with the rule named; no transaction
steps.observed: done: refused; proposal allowed false; failing rule: Per-conversion limit in the owner's signed mandate; transaction none

steps.name: an attack that skims the output of a genuine order
steps.expected: mined as a revert; balances unchanged
steps.observed: done: reverted; reverted NotBestExecution; treasury unchanged

steps.name: the engine ticks the standing policy by itself, with no request from an interface
steps.expected: within one five-minute slot a tick appears that nothing but the engine asked for; it converts a tranche, waits, or finds the target met
steps.observed: after 200 s: tick 1 done: executed; decision "convert" convert 12149472 now (limited by need); expected 10892484 at 81.4 bps execution

steps.name: a standing policy, then one tick under it without a new signature
steps.expected: policy active; the tick converts a tranche, waits, or finds the target met
steps.observed: done: executed; policy active target 20; tick done: no-action; decision "none" reserve is at or above its target: nothing to do

steps.name: pause, try to convert, resume
steps.expected: paused; the conversion does not go through; resumed
steps.observed: pause done: executed; conversion while paused done: refused; resume done: executed

steps.name: a payment after conversions have used the earned allowance
steps.expected: the read says nothing can be paid; sent anyway it is refused, naming the co-signer's allowance; nothing leaves
steps.observed: most payable 0, allowance left 0; done: refused; Refused before signing: a payment of 3.00 tUSD to CloudCo is more than is left of the co-signer's earned allowance. No transaction was sent.

steps.name: the vault service re-hashes its decision records
steps.expected: chain intact
steps.observed: ok true; 19 records

steps.name: another owner of this installation cannot read or use the vault
steps.expected: told it is another's; no state; reads and actions refused
steps.observed: whose another; state withheld; read 403 rail_not_yours; action 403 rail_not_yours
